subject: Weekly MAP update — BrightCap renewal & expansion cadence
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle@brightcap.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly MAP update — BrightCap renewal & expansion cadence

Hi Danielle / Mark,

Following our MAP, here is the short weekly checkpoint for BrightCap's renewal and expansion path. TL;DR: usage is trending up, two pilots are on schedule, and the proposed add-on pricing for the Data Connectors needs internal approval this week for the launch on March 1.

Status snapshot:
- Renewal target: 2026-03-15 (contract expires 2026-03-31) — on track.
- Current usage: 5.2M tokens/month — up 18% last 30 days.
- Pilot teams: FraudOps (kickoff 2/23), Marketing Insights (POC start 3/2).

Open items & owners (quick):
1) Finalize add-on price sheet (owner: Rishi) — due 2026-02-18.
2) Provide SOC2 evidence for procurement checklist (owner: Monica) — due 2026-02-19.
3) DocuSign SOW for renewal term + Data Connectors (owner: Karthik) — target 2026-03-05.

Attachments: BrightCap_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones) and usage-runbook.pdf (how we track token consumption).

Questions for you: can we confirm the FraudOps kickoff time (week of 2/23)? Also, are there any internal procurement hurdles for approving the connector add-on?

Next steps: I'll capture any change requests and update the MAP by Thursday EOD. If you'd prefer a quick 15-min sync instead of email, I'm happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119

Thanks Karthik — adding a couple of notes from procurement/security:

- SOC2 artifacts: I pulled the attestation and the controls matrix. Uploading to the shared secure folder now (see attachment stub).
- Data retention question from their legal team: default retention is 30 days for payloads, customer can request custom retention via Private deployment agreement. Monica to draft language for procurement (due 2/19).

Action updates:
- SOC2 evidence: Monica — uploaded, see link in MAP (BrightCap_MAP_v2.xlsx).
- FraudOps kickoff: confirmed for 2/24 10:00 AM PT. Danielle, please confirm attendee list.

I'll follow up with Security if BrightCap requests narrower retention options.

Monica Patel

monica@redwood.ai

From: Danielle Brooks <danielle@brightcap.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Turner <mark.turner@brightcap.io>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP update — BrightCap renewal & expansion cadence

Thanks Karthik & Monica — appreciate the quick turnaround on SOC2. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- FraudOps kickoff: 2/24 10:00 AM PT works; attendees will be myself, Mark (Head of Fraud), and our SRE lead Olivia Park.
- Usage: confirmed 5.2M tokens; Marketing Insights pilot expected to add another ~600k tokens/month during POC ramp.
- Procurement: legal has a question about the retention phrasing Monica mentioned — they'd like an explicit retention clause for data older than 90 days to be export-only (no inference access). Does Redwood support a read-only archive option?

We also want to lock the add-on pricing as discussed — can you share the final price sheet and the preferred start date for connectors?

Thanks,
Danielle Brooks
Director, Platform Strategy — BrightCap Analytics
danielle@brightcap.io

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle@brightcap.io>, Mark Turner <mark.turner@brightcap.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP update — BrightCap renewal & expansion cadence

Hi Danielle / Mark — thanks for confirming attendees. Quick answers and commitments: 

- Retention/read-only archive: Yes, we support an export-only archive for data >90 days in Private deployments — I'll loop Security to produce the precise clause. Monica, could you confirm the suggested language by Monday?
- Add-on pricing: Rishi, see below for the proposed sheet. Rishi — can you finalize and share a redline by EOD Monday 2/23? We want to set a planned connector start date of 2026-03-01 to align with the Marketing Insights POC.
- DocuSign: I'm prepping the renewal SOW with the add-on as an appendix. I'll send the envelope by 2026-03-05. Danielle, once DocuSign is in, would you be able to route to procurement for a 5-business-day turnaround?

Proposed pricing (summary):
- Base renewal: $180k / year (no change)
- Data Connectors add-on: $2,500 / connector / month (first two connectors discounted 25% for first 6 months)
- Volume credit: usage tiers unchanged; we'll keep the current 10% volume discount at >=10M tokens/month.

Action list (updated):
A) Rishi — finalize connector pricing sheet and share redline (due 2026-02-23).
B) Monica — finalize retention clause wording for procurement (due 2026-02-23).
C) Karthik — send SOW via DocuSign with add-on appendix (target 2026-03-05).

I'll keep the MAP updated; attaching BrightCap_MAP_v2.xlsx with the dates highlighted.

Best,
Karthik

If BrightCap confirms the start date 2026-03-01 we can honor the discount and align invoicing to the renewal term.

Danielle — let me know if you'd like a short breakdown of expected monthly spend given your projected usage (I can run a 3-month projection).
